enable-spectator-camera.name: Enable spectator camera
enable-spectator-camera.hint: Enable or disable the automatic spectator camera system

spectator-user.name: Spectator User
spectator-user.hint: Select the user account that should act as the automated spectator camera.

image-popout-timeout.name: Image Popout Auto Close Time
image-popout-timeout.hint: How long image popouts should remain visible for the spectator camera before automatically closing, measured in seconds. Set to 0 to disable automatic closing.

toggle-spectator-combat-mode.name: Toggle spectator camera combat mode
toggle-spectator-combat-mode.hint: Toggle the combat mode for the spectator camera
